metadata.notes: edshield 0.2.0 (source commit a568e73), policy coppa, detector rules+model, runtime python. Rows are residuals measured on the final output of edshield.deidentify(verify=False); a surrogate equal to a gold string counts as a residual. Exporter edshield-evidence 0.1.0; judge model-evidence v2.0.0.

document.description: One row per document with at least one gold span. y_true = 1; y_pred = 1 when no gold span survives whole in that document's output.

identifier.description: One row per gold identifier span (cluster = document). y_true = 1; y_pred = 1 when the normalized gold string no longer occurs as a whole word in the final de-identified text.

word.description: One row per whitespace token of the original (cluster = document). y_true = 1 if the token overlaps a gold span; y_pred = 1 if the token was replaced or removed in the output. fpr is over-redaction.

type:AGE.description: Identifier rows restricted to gold label AGE.
